items.title: Madrid-based Wilco secures €2.5 million to scale its AI patient follow-up platform across Europe
items.summary: Wilco, a Madrid-based startup building AI voice and messaging agents for healthcare clinic groups, has announced its launch and a new €2.5 million funding round. The round was led by Samaipata, the European venture capital fund known for backing marketplace and software businesses across the continent.
